authored_distribution.policy: Slices are chosen from the project's own live claim/slice topology, bound only to already-approved claim-bound scenes, spread through each claim so contextual footage interleaves with primary evidence, and capped by the blueprint's per-source use budget. No unreviewed footage and no automatic backfill.
